raw.query: SELECT c.model, c.resolution, SUM(ABS(c.y_true-c.point))/SUM(ABS(c.y_true)) AS wape_direct, SUM(ABS((-183.6655+1878.3248*r.point+72.1790*i.point)-c.y_true))/SUM(ABS(c.y_true)) AS wape_additive FROM v_forecast_thesis_corpus c JOIN v_forecast_thesis_corpus r ON r.model=c.model AND r.mode=c.mode AND r.resolution=c.resolution AND r.ts=c.ts AND r.h=c.h AND r.step=c.step AND r.variate='requests' JOIN v_forecast_thesis_corpus i ON i.model=c.model AND i.mode=c.mode AND i.resolution=c.resolution AND i.ts=c.ts AND i.h=c.h AND i.step=c.step AND i.variate='images' WHERE c.variate='ctx' AND c.mode='uni' AND c.model IN ('chronos','toto') AND c.resolution IN ('1min','15s') GROUP BY c.model,c.resolution
